message:
The other day, while sipping my morning coffee, I heard the weather report talking about a big storm rolling in. I glanced at my daughter, who was busy scrolling through her phone, and said, "Remember when I insisted we stock up on candles and snacks last time?" She rolled her eyes, but guess who was smiling when the lights flickered and the winds howled? 

Sure, it felt a bit smug, but honestly, it’s nice to be prepared sometimes. A little planning can turn a scary situation into a cozy family campout right in your living room. 

So, what’s your go-to tip for a stormy day? 🌧️
